summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Next Day Disclosure Return (HKEX form) detailing ongoing share repurchases. The registrant has repurchased for cancellation a total of over 11 million Class A ordinary shares between March 20 and April 15, 2026, with prices ranging from roughly USD 6.57 to 7.14 per share. The buyback is conducted on-market under Hong Kong listing rules, with shares not yet cancelled as of June 10. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The program returns capital to shareholders, reducing float (over 1.3% of shares repurchased). Watch for further repurchase updates and final cancellation to assess capital return pace.
